description: Put labels on a thread or take them off, by id. The labels are the workspace's, the same ones contacts use (list_labels, create_label), and everyone in the workspace sees them. A label it already has, or doesn't have, is left alone. Answers 404 when a label or the thread is not this workspace's, with nothing changed. The mailbox itself never sees labels. A key an owner limited to some mailboxes and agent inboxes can't do this on a thread that also holds mail from another mailbox: it answers 403 with `details.scope` `keyReads`.

add.description: Labels to put on the thread, by id (list_labels).

idempotencyKey.description: Your own id for this one call, such as a UUID, up to 255 characters. If the call fails with no answer, call again with the same key and the same arguments: within 24 hours, a saved answer comes back instead of a second run. A call left unanswered can run again after 15 minutes, so a send also keeps its intentKey or draft revision.

remove.description: Labels to take off it. One the thread doesn't carry is left alone.

name: set_thread_labels
title: Label a thread
